Brought CRUCIBLE and Tinyshop pipeline infra into v1.9 spec: runs.jsonl, incidents.jsonl, evals/, trigger tables
Tinyshop: pipeline-agnostic manifest system — decoupled all v1.8-hardcoded roles, paths, parsing, scaffolding, and UI from pipeline version. Auto-detects v1.8 vs v1.9.
Live Deck Monitor: 2-deck real-time waveform with auto-scrolling cursor, composite key track resolution, full diagnostic metadata. Java bridge emits playback_position_ms via TimeFinder.
Runtime hardening: jq-free hooks (python3 JSON parsing), git-guard fails closed, state-snapshot.py produces valid JSON, pyproject.toml addopts disables ambient plugins
Assessment fidelity: index-conversations.py indexes 149 transcripts, assess.py sorts by mtime, computes reads_before_edit, reports sampled session IDs
Core pipeline evals: all SCUE tests behind scue_available skipif guard, trigger table test checks pipeline-only skills, convention tests skip when projects absent
Artifact bootstrap: runs.jsonl + incidents.jsonl + state-snapshot.json bootstrapped, TestRequiredArtifacts fails on missing (not skips), audit-run-record stop hook warns
Variant runner: experiment.py loads YAML configs, resolves solver by name, instantiates per-variant model/solver/budget/TTL, prints comparison table
Workspace benchmark tasks: fix-short-track-bpm and build-health-endpoint use inline fixture code with deterministic_fix_check and deterministic_endpoint_check scorers

Deterministic scoring: code_quality uses structural signals (has_code, has_types, has_test, is_minimal, no_any), efficiency uses char/tool/runtime counts. LLM judge is optional secondary via code_quality_llm()

Live pipeline runner: claude_code_with_skills solver loads CLAUDE.md + flow SKILL.md + domain skills as system prompt. bare_prompt solver provides control group. experiment.py comparison mode shows per-variant results
Doc cleanup: run-evals.sh labeled LEGACY with pytest pointer, manifest.md updated to v2.0 versions and actual test counts, CLAUDE.md updated to v2.1 with experiment framework section

Review cycle 2026-03-24: three-lens analysis (A: efficiency, B: quality, C: knowledge) across 25 sessions. Synthesized into 12 improvement candidates. Tier 1 implemented: LEARNINGS.md, SCUE component API ref, diagnostic-before-visual rule, fix-tracker threshold 2.

Pipeline hardening: 8-item improvement rollout — policy alignment (2-attempt cap), fix-attempt-tracker expansion (Write+reset+8 hook tests), task closure enforcement (audit hook + eval + 11 backfills), stale artifact removal, root/project learnings split, component API loading path, diagnostic-before-visual eval. 64 evals all green.

Section-based review system: 6 SCUE sections (bridge, analysis, strata, pipeline, server, frontend) defined by real dataflow boundaries. 1-page contracts, coupling map, parallelization rules, three-pass review skill, 9 boundary enforcement evals + file coverage. SYNTROPY archived. Siloing guidance added to CLAUDE.md, feature-flow, refactor-flow, and section-review skill (re-evaluate after session batches).
Review-cycle skill: encode the three-lens process, session selection, batching, and synthesis as a reusable skill in skills/review-cycle/SKILL.md
Edit() hygiene rule: add guidance to all 3 flow skills — if >3 sequential Edit() on same file, use Write() instead. Reduces edit-cycling anti-pattern (8/25 sessions).
Session scope guideline: add to all 3 flow skills — cap sessions at 1-2 objectives. Sessions with 4+ objectives consistently score 2-3/5 efficiency.
Phase handoff prompt template: formalize the handoff-prompt pattern (emergent in sessions 4,8,14) as a template in templates/phase-handoff.md

Token Dashboard: self-contained HTML visualization of token consumption & context usage across Claude Code sessions. Multi-session monitor view with toggle-on/off panels, recency/project filtering, burn rate + context fill + per-turn cost + tool breakdown charts. Compare tab for overlay curves. Projects tab for aggregate stats.
